title: validate_edit_agent_json
description: Top-level envelope emitted by `agent-use validate-edit --agent-json`. It wraps the inner validation_packet (validation_packet_agent_json.schema.json) and adds the agent decision/safety surface, evidence-first compaction handles, and the agent-use profile identity. additionalProperties is true: compact mode may shed optional metadata while retaining the required evidence/decision core (evidence-first shedding).

severity_summary.description: Counts and max_severity for blocking/warning/unknown/diagnostic findings.

claimability.description: Graph/source claimability summary for the validated edit; proof boundary is preserved.

must_fix_before_continuing.description: Blocking findings the agent must resolve before continuing; empty/false when none.

hard_interrupt.description: Hard-interrupt packet (hard_interrupt_agent_json.schema.json) when a blocking contradiction exists; null otherwise.

unresolved_references.description: MVP3.9.5.4 unresolved-reference lane summary (counts, by_class, escalated). not_graph_proof.

expansion_handles.description: Handles for explain/audit expansion of detail shed in compact mode.

micro_edge_delta.description: MVP4.2 micro-edge delta summary; optional, graph claimability separate from micro-edge availability.

micro_edge_integrity.description: MVP4.2 micro-edge integrity substage summary; optional.

micro_edge_layer_status.description: MVP4.2 micro-edge layer availability status; optional.

micro_flow_packet_delta.description: MVP4.3 local micro-flow packet delta summary; normal packet deltas are not source-code errors.

micro_flow_packet_integrity.description: MVP4.3 local micro-flow packet integrity substage summary; optional.

micro_flow_packet_layer_status.description: MVP4.3 local micro-flow packet layer availability status; optional and separate from graph/micro-edge availability.

micro_flow_packet_proof_changes.description: MVP4.3 local micro-flow packet proof-change summary; compact output uses handles and does not inline ordered_steps.
